answer.rationale: The low-cost vendor is the only quoted option that meets the mandated 18% spend reduction, while the incumbent has refused to reduce price. Archived experience indicates this vendor onboarded quickly and invoiced accurately, supporting a guarded transition. Because the line is already at 94% of committed volume with no buffer, start with a limited, monitored allocation rather than an unmitigated full-volume switch; delivery continuity remains the key downstream risk.
